_comment: P3 grader-gap campaign (experiment 006 reservoir-inflow, solver-catches mode). SINGLE-ARM by design: unlike e004/e005 this is NOT a context-injection A/B. Each model appears ONCE; the same authored artifact is graded two ways by the evaluator (visible `check`/`test` near-ceiling vs the WITHHELD ceiling post under fixpoint). Per-cell metric: solver_caught = (test PASS) AND (verify REFUTED) on the obvious-but-wrong fill; grade A = refuted (the catch), B = verified-clean, C = vacuous, F = non-compile/missing. Grading mode auto-resolves to solver_catches because hidden-specs/006.json exists (prepare_run.py:482-486). run_matrix.py aggregates solver_caught/solver_catch_measured (run_matrix.py:329-347,371). HYPOTHESIS: a strong LLM's obvious fill passes the non-adversarial visible check but fails the withheld ceiling post under fixpoint -> verify-pass below ceiling with a test-verify gap whose CI excludes 0. NULL: both pass (obvious impl already correct / contract restates body). run_count=5 (the discriminating quantity is a mid-range rate, needs tighter CI than the saturated 3-try pilots).
_feasibility_gate: RUN ON BRANCH feat/defret-grader-gap-p3 ONLY — experiment 006, hidden-specs/006.json, scaffold-templates/reservoir-inflow, and the solver_catches grader path in scripts/ are NOT on main. F-009.2/F-009.3 binary preflight: `llmll version` must report >= 0.13.2 (DEF-RET + grader-gap build); a stale binary false-nulls every cell. Confirmed 0.13.2 on PATH at authoring. Before the billed run: (1) `llmll version` >= 0.13.2; (2) `--prepare-only` dry-run and confirm grading_mode=solver_catches in each run dir's metadata, the scaffold is provided, hidden-specs/006.json is NOT copied into any agent-visible dir, and no `_`-prefixed key (e.g. _fixture_note) survives in the prepared scaffold.
_cmd_note: Confirm model IDs against your auth tier before launch: (1) codex 'gpt-5.5' uses bare `codex exec` with NO --model flag (API-key-only models are auth-rejected on ChatGPT-tier accounts, postmortem-001 F-102). (2) Gemini slot is gemini-2.0-pro-exp-02-05 — the deliberate Phase-3 step-down from gemini-3-pro-preview (project memory: gemini-3 throttling 529s nulled e005's Gemini cells). Gemini-2-vs-3 is a DEFERRED sub-experiment, gated on throttling resolution; do not silently restore gemini-3 here. (3) claude model id is claude-opus-4-8.
